name: M9Bayonet
note: The Assault's execution knife (ClassKnives.csv). The pack's models come in at three quarters of their size at the project's 0.01905 m a unit (this one 22.8 cm), so scale 4/3 makes it the real M9's 30.4 cm. The blade runs to -Z with its sawback (spine) on +X and its edge on -X, so tip [0,0,-1] and up [1,0,0]; the origin is the middle of the handle, behind the 6 cm crossguard. Markers: Tip, Edge (mid-blade), Pommel.
